decisions.decision: Social/community launch requires manual Michael execution on Roblox Creator Dashboard, Discord, and Roblox Group — agent produces checklist only

principles.text: Every checklist item must be concrete, copy-pasteable, or link to an existing artifact
principles.interpretation: No ambiguity in action items. Each references exact paths, commits, or UI locations.

principles.text: Social/community prep is Michael-only execution — no code patch needed
principles.interpretation: Roblox Dashboard, Discord server, Roblox Group creation require human login and manual actions.

principles.text: Pre-write content before launch day — draft during T-108h, post on day 0
principles.interpretation: Launch day is not the time to compose announcements. Pre-write DevForum post, Discord messages, group shouts.

principles.text: First 48 hours is the engagement playbook — execute E1-E7 in sequence
principles.interpretation: Hour 0: flip public + post. Hour 1: play. Hour 2-6: monitor bug reports. Hour 12: update. Hour 24: thank you. Hour 48: balance patch.

principles.text: incubator application tie-in needs live game URL, player metrics, and community size
principles.interpretation: Before submitting Apr 6, have game live, track first 48h player count, count group + Discord members.

session_context: Social Launch & Community Readiness Checklist at T-108h. Game code complete (41 Lua modules). 21 Product IDs blocker. Store listing copy, QA test plan, monitoring plan all done. Missing: social/community prep for launch day. Checklist covers Roblox game page (A), Roblox group (B), Discord (C), launch day content (D), 48hr engagement playbook (E), incubator tie-in (F). All Michael-only execution items.
